parameters.name: BillOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource ownership account. This is the account that actually uses the resources.

parameters.name: EndPeriod
parameters.description: The end time of the savings plan. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The query excludes this time. If empty, the query ends at the current time.

parameters.name: PeriodType
parameters.description: The time dimension of the savings plan. MONTH: monthly. DAY: daily. HOUR: hourly.

parameters.name: StartPeriod
parameters.description: The start time of the savings plan. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The query includes this time.
